description: §61.7 — an `<endpoint>` whose `path=` (`/fsp?v=1`) has a query (`?`) is outside the §61.7 path grammar: E-ENDPOINT-PATH-INVALID (Error), and nothing else.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 5 (`E-ENDPOINT-PATH-INVALID`; reserve `/_scrml_local/`); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S478-open-Qs-item-37 (the grammar)
rationale: §61.7: "A `path=` SHALL be an absolute path: it begins with `/`, and every other character is an RFC 3986 unreserved character (`A`–`Z`, `a`–`z`, `0`–`9`, `-`, `.`, `_`, `~`) or `/`. No segment is empty (`//`), `.` or `..` … A `path=` outside this grammar is `E-ENDPOINT-PATH-INVALID` (§61.9), reported at the `<endpoint>` opener."
